<style>
  /* --- GLOBAL CARD COLOR THEME --- */
  :root {
    --card-bg: #f4f9fc; 
    --card-border: #031C59; 
    --text-main: #031C59; 
  }

  /* This completely fixes the Dark Mode issue by catching all Quarto theme toggles */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --card-bg: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1);
    --card-border: #99ddff;
    --text-main: #f3f3f3;
  }

  /* --- TIMELINE CARD STYLES --- */
  .timeline-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-left: 5px solid var(--card-border); 
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; 
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
  }

  .timeline-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15); 
  }

  /* Logo Zone (Vertical Stack on Desktop) */
  .timeline-logo-zone {
    flex: 0 0 220px;
    background: #ffffff;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column; 
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    gap: 30px; 
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .timeline-logo-zone,
  body.quarto-dark .timeline-logo-zone,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .timeline-logo-zone {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); /* Keeps logos visible in dark mode */
  }

  .timeline-logo-zone img {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 140px;
    height: auto;
    max-height: 75px; 
    object-fit: contain; 
  }

  /* Content Zone */
  .timeline-content {
    padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .timeline-content h3 {
    margin-top: 0;
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  .timeline-meta {
    color: var(--card-border);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* Badge fixes for perfect contrast */
  .timeline-meta .badge {
    background-color: var(--card-border);
    color: #ffffff; 
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .timeline-meta .badge,
  body.quarto-dark .timeline-meta .badge,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .timeline-meta .badge {
    color: #031C59 !important; /* Forces dark blue text on the light blue background */
  }

  .timeline-content p, .timeline-content ul {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .timeline-content ul {
    padding-left: 1.2rem;
  }

  .timeline-content li {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }
  
  .timeline-content li:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  /* Clean class for the Hoche note */
  .timeline-note {
    margin-top: 10px; 
    font-size: 0.85rem; 
    color: var(--card-border);
  }

  /* Mobile Stacking */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .timeline-card {
      flex-direction: column;
      border-radius: 12px; 
      border-left: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-top: 5px solid var(--card-border); 
    }
    .timeline-logo-zone {
      flex: auto;
      flex-direction: row; 
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center; 
      gap: 25px; 
      border-right: none;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
    .timeline-content {
      padding: 1.5rem;
    }
  }
</style>

<div class="timeline-content">
<h3>Post-Doctoral Researcher (ANR Rosaly)</h3>
<div class="timeline-meta">
<span class="badge">12/2025 - 11/2027</span>
<span>Laboratoire de Mécanique des Solides, IP Paris, UMR 7649, CNRS</span>
</div>
<p><strong>Supervisor:</strong> Jean-Marc Allain</p>
<p>Leading the poromechanical modelling and characterization of collagen hydrogels embedded with smooth muscle cells. The core work involves using experimental data to identify the material’s mechanical properties based on its fabrication conditions.</p>
<p>A key objective is the enhancement of poroelastic models (implemented in FEniCS) to incorporate the complex influence of contractile cells within the gel, specifically including their mechanoperception response. Further development will integrate microstructural information to accurately describe how collagen fibers move and reorient under mechanical load.</p>
</div>
</div>

<h3>Post-Doctoral Researcher (ANR MATISSE)</h3>
<div class="timeline-meta">
<span class="badge">09/2025 - 11/2025</span>
<span>Institut de mécanique et d'ingénierie (I2M), Univ. Bordeaux INP, UMR 5295, CNRS</span>
</div>
<p><strong>Supervisor:</strong> Giuseppe Sciumè</p>
<p>Extended multi-compartment poromechanical models for biological soft tissues and porous liquids using the advanced finite element software FEniCSx.</p>
<p>In addition to leading simulations, I provided essential computational and numerical support to four PhD students to help them overcome technical hurdles. A key institutional responsibility involved the HPC installation of FEniCSx on the MCIA High-Performance Computing cluster, including the creation of comprehensive documentation.</p>
